en:
I do think that once we find everything,
it will all connect.

I don't want to agree with Kokichi, but...
it certainly feels that way.
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Maki for a while?

What's your opinion as a detective? Do you
think our scattered memories will make sense?

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time with Maki,
discussing our memories.
<CLT=cltMIND>Maki and I grew a little closer today.
